receipts.detail: terminal dissolution clears the tables transition row (state + metadata + pending epoch all null), releases the in-memory workflow, and leaves the durable row admissible for a second split — the F9 wedge is gone
non-participating sibling descriptors are promoted into the split target epoch at cutover (fail-closed on a zero-row update); abort restores them — sibling key ranges never strand
the durable cutover writes partition_count = targetIds + carried-forward siblings = oldCount + 1, promotes the pending epoch to active, and clears the pending column
a FAILED split transition withdraws pending_partition_version in the same mutation (no pending visibility), leaving the source authoritative at the active epoch
SPLIT_COMPLETED fires exactly once at terminal (after the transition row clears), never at plan time or cutover, with the planner-result payload shape the stabilization-reset listener consumes
